name: swirlspin
description: The real SwirlOS logo, extruded into 3D and spinning.
author: Swirl
title: Swirl Spin
long: The real SwirlOS logo as a solid 3D shape, rotating in its own window.\nDrag with the mouse to spin it, Space pauses, + and - change the speed, C cycles colours (logo, neon, gold, mono), R resets.
